figures.name: Orunmila

ability.name: Ifa Oracle
ability.description: Look at all enemy cards and all future draws; choose one to discard.

figures.description: Divine witness of creation who knows every human destiny and teaches divination through the Ifa system.

figures.name: Shango

ability.name: Thunderstone Axe
ability.description: Deal 7 thunder damage; enemies struck lose 2 power from divine justice.

figures.description: Warrior king deified as the Orisha of thunder and lightning who executes justice from the sky.

figures.name: Ogun

ability.name: Iron Path
ability.description: Destroy one enemy shield or armor; deal 5 damage that cannot be blocked.

figures.description: Fierce Orisha of iron, war and all who use metal tools, who opened the road of civilization.

figures.name: Yemoja

ability.name: Ocean's Embrace
ability.description: Heal all allies for 4 HP; water-aligned allies gain +3 defense.

figures.description: Great mother Orisha of the ocean who protects all children and is the source of all waters.

figures.name: Oya

ability.name: Tempest of Change
ability.description: Shuffle all positions on the field; remove all buffs and debuffs from every card.

figures.description: Warrior goddess of storms, the Niger River and the winds of change who guards the gate between life and death.

figures.name: Obatala

ability.name: White Cloth
ability.description: Negate all chaos and dark abilities directed at any ally for 1 turn.

figures.description: Creator of human bodies who molds each person from white clay; Orisha of purity, peace and compassion.

figures.name: Eshu/Elegba

ability.name: Crossroads Choice
ability.description: Force one enemy to choose between losing 4 power or 4 wisdom — you decide which they pick.

figures.description: Divine trickster and messenger at the crossroads who must be propitiated first in every ceremony.

figures.name: Osun

ability.name: Sweet River
ability.description: Restore 5 HP to one ally; grant +2 magic to all love and water allies.

figures.description: Orisha of the Osun River, love, fertility and art whose brass mirror and honey reflect the sweetness of life.

figures.name: Orunmila

ability.name: Ifa Oracle
ability.description: Look at all enemy cards and all future draws; choose one to discard.

figures.description: Divine witness of creation who knows every human destiny and teaches divination through the Ifa system.

figures.name: Ori

ability.name: Inner Head
ability.description: Grant one ally: their next ability automatically succeeds and deals maximum effect.

figures.description: Each person's personal Orisha — the individual divine essence that determines one's unique destiny.

figures.name: Osoosi

ability.name: Unerring Arrow
ability.description: Deal 6 damage ignoring all evasion or dodge abilities.

figures.description: Hunter Orisha of the forest and tracking who never misses his target and protects communities.

figures.name: Obaluaye

ability.name: Plague and Cure
ability.description: Deal 3 disease damage to all enemies; then heal all allies for 2.

figures.description: Orisha of earth, disease and healing who has power over all sicknesses and their cures.

figures.name: Aganju

ability.name: Volcanic Path
ability.description: Deal 4 fire damage to all enemies; grant allies crossing ability for 1 turn.

figures.description: Orisha of the wilderness and volcanoes, father of Shango, who governs all wild uncrossable places.

figures.name: Nana Buluku

ability.name: Ancient Decree
ability.description: Your next 3 ability plays cannot be countered by any enemy reaction.

figures.description: The most ancient creator deity of the Yoruba, androgynous parent of Mawu and Lisa, before all Orishas.

figures.name: Egungun

ability.name: Ancestral Masquerade
ability.description: Grant all allies +2 to all stats from ancestral blessing for 1 turn.

figures.description: Collective spirit of honored ancestors who appear in masquerade to bless and counsel the living community.

figures.name: Olokun

ability.name: Abyssal Depth
ability.description: Drag one enemy to the deep: they lose 3 magic and cannot use spiritual abilities for 1 turn.

figures.description: Orisha of the deep ocean floor who holds unfathomable wealth and governs the mysteries below all waters.

figures.name: Obba

ability.name: Devoted Cut
ability.description: Sacrifice 3 of this card's HP to grant one ally +4 magic from the power of sacrifice.

figures.description: Devoted wife who cut off her own ear to cook for Shango in an act of love that ended in rejection.

figures.name: Ibeji

ability.name: Twin Luck
ability.description: All luck-based or random abilities this turn trigger twice.

figures.description: Sacred twin Orishas of luck and playfulness who bring double blessings to twins and their families.

figures.name: Osanyin

ability.name: Herb Doctor
ability.description: Remove all disease and poison effects from all allies.

figures.description: One-eyed, one-armed Orisha of herbal medicine who knows the healing power of every plant in the forest.

figures.name: Otin

ability.name: River Warrior
ability.description: Deal 4 damage and restore 2 HP to this card from river strength.

figures.description: Fierce female Orisha of the Otin River who participates in war and hunting alongside the male Orishas.
